content.user_title: Improve Prose With Clear Style Rules
content.value_statement: Technical writing often becomes wordy, vague, or hard to scan. This skill applies concise style rules to drafts, documentation, messages, and user-facing copy.
actual_capabilities: Applies Strunk style rules for grammar, punctuation, paragraph structure, and concise composition.
Guides edits for documentation, commit messages, pull request descriptions, reports, UI copy, and error text.
Uses a local public-domain Elements of Style reference when detailed guidance is useful.
Offers a short-rule fallback based on Orwell writing rules when context is limited.
Encourages active voice, positive statements, specific language, and omission of needless words.
limitations: It does not verify facts, citations, or technical correctness.
It may preserve dated usage guidance from the 1918 reference.
It cannot enforce a team style guide unless the prompt includes that guide.
The full reference can use significant context on long tasks.

use_cases.title: Polish Technical Documentation
use_cases.description: Improve README sections, guides, and explanations so readers can understand them faster.

use_cases.title: Tighten Developer Messages
use_cases.description: Rewrite commit messages, pull request summaries, and code comments with direct wording.

use_cases.title: Improve Product Copy
use_cases.description: Make UI text, help content, and release notes clearer without changing the meaning.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Short Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner copyedit for a paragraph or short message.
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this paragraph for clear, concise prose. Preserve meaning and show the revised version first: [paste draft]

prompt_templates.title: Improve Documentation
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused edit for docs, guides, or README content.
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this documentation section using active voice and fewer needless words. Keep headings and technical terms: [paste text]

prompt_templates.title: Tighten Product Copy
prompt_templates.scenario: Copyedit for UI text, help content, or release notes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Revise this UI or help text for direct language. List the main changes after the revision: [paste text]

prompt_templates.title: Apply Style Rules With Constraints
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced edit with required wording, audience, and review notes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Copyedit this draft against the skill guidance. Preserve required terms. Note uncertain wording and explain the highest-impact changes: [paste draft and constraints]

output_examples.input: Due to the fact that the deployment failed, it is necessary for us to perform an investigation.
output_examples.output: Because the deployment failed, we need to investigate. The revision removes needless words and uses direct verbs.

output_examples.input: The button was clicked by the user and then an error was shown.
output_examples.output: The user clicked the button, and the app showed an error. The revision uses active voice and names the actor.

output_examples.input: This is a very interesting feature that is used for the purpose of helping teams collaborate.
output_examples.output: This feature helps teams collaborate. The revision removes empty emphasis and states the value directly.

best_practices: Provide the audience, format, and required terms with each draft.
Ask for the revised text first, then a short explanation of major edits.
Use the full reference for important prose and the shorter rules for small edits.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to change facts or technical claims without source material.
Do not paste secrets or private customer data into drafts.
Do not request a full rewrite when only a sentence-level copyedit is needed.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps AI edit prose for clarity, brevity, active voice, and stronger sentence structure.

faq.question: Can it write new content?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft prose, but it is strongest when given a draft and a purpose.

faq.question: Does it run commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill contains Markdown guidance and a local reference file; it does not run commands.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It is marked as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it replace a human editor?
faq.answer: No. Use it as a first-pass editor, then review tone, facts, and audience fit.

faq.question: What should I include in my prompt?
faq.answer: Include the draft, target reader, desired format, required terms, and any style constraints.
